body: announced they are ending the Solar for All program
official termination notice for the Alaska Tribal Solar for All program from the EPA
TCC has halted work on the program and paused the selection process

TCC is working with other Alaskan partners, including Alaska Native Tribal Health Consortium (ANTHC), Alaska Housing Finance Corporation (AHFC), and Alaska Energy Authority (AEA) to determine further action.
is saddened to share this news, but remains
committed to securing other funding opportunities as they become available
